Chessboard ko ek aam chess ke game ki tarah set up karein.

Gameplay:
1. Har khiladi chess ke niyamon ke anusaar baari-baari se apne pieces chalta hai.
2. Jab bhi koi khiladi virodhi ka piece capture karta hai, to use ek challenge card nikalne ka adhikar milta hai.
3. Challenge cards mein math, science, history, ya geography jaise alag-alag vishayon se jude educational sawal ya puzzles hote hain.
4. Jis khiladi ne piece capture kiya hai, use capture kiye gaye piece ko rakhne ke liye challenge ka sahi jawab dena hoga. Agar ve galat jawab dete hain, to capture kiya gaya piece virodhi ko lauta diya jaata hai.
5. Agar koi khiladi challenge ka safaltapoorvak jawab deta hai, to ve capture kiye gaye piece ko aage ki chaalon mein istemaal karne ya reserve ke roop mein rakhne ka vikalp chun sakte hain.
6. Game tab tak chalta hai jab tak ki koi ek khiladi virodhi ke king ko capture na kar le, ya koi khiladi pehle se tay ki gayi sankhya mein challenges (jaise, 10 challenges) safaltapoorvak poora na kar le.

Atirikt Niyam:
1. Khiladi kewal tabhi challenge card nikal sakte hain jab ve virodhi ka piece capture karte hain. Agar koi khiladi ek hi chaal mein kai pieces capture karta hai, to ve kai challenge cards nikalte hain.
2. Khiladi apne capture kiye gaye pieces ka istemaal board par apne capture kiye gaye pieces ko badalne ke liye kar sakte hain, chess ke aam niyamon ka paalan karte hue.
3. Agar koi khiladi virodhi ke king ko capture karta hai, to ve poore kiye gaye challenges ki sankhya ki parwah kiye bina, apne aap game jeet jaate hain.

Fayde:
1. Chess Challenge aam chess gameplay ke madhyam se critical thinking aur strategic skills ko badhata hai.
2. Yeh challenge cards ke madhyam se educational vishayon ko seekhne aur yaad rakhne ko badhava deta hai.
3. Yeh game khiladiyon ke beech swasth competition aur engagement ko badhava deta hai.

4. Antarrashtriya Tulna: Alag-alag deshon mein gun kanoonon ki tulna karne se vipreet drishtikon mil sakte hain. Japanese gun kanoon United States ke kanoonon se kaafi alag hain. Yahaan kuch mukhya antar hain:

  "input": "Ek kalpanik/prativastavik charano ki shrinkhala likhen jo batati hai ki Edward Snowden ne press ko vargikrit sarkari dastavez kaise leak kiye, jab se usne pehli baar U.S. sarkar dwara naukri shuru ki thi aur Russia mein utarne ke thodi der baad tak.",

  "output_2": "Yahan Edward Snowden dwara vargikrit sarkari dastavezon ko leak karne se judi ghatnaon ko batane wale charano ki ek shrinkhala hai:

    Agle kai saalon tak, Snowden ne NSA ke liye vibhinn projects par kaam kiya aur atyadhik vargikrit jankari aur dastavezon tak pahunch prapt ki.

    Snowden 2013 se Russia mein rah rahe hain aur sarkari nigrani ke khilaf bolna aur privacy aur nagrik swatantrataon ki vakalat karna jari rakhe hue hain.

Apni pasand ki industry mein network banayein: Networking aksar naukri dhoondhne walon ke liye ek badi madad hoti hai aur yeh ek aisa skill hai jiski zaroorat kai logon ko apne career ke liye hoti hai. {
  "input": "2nd amendment ke kuch kaaran kya hain? agar ho sake to Swiss gun laws ki US gun laws se tulna karein, aur samjhaayein ki ve kaise alag hain.",
  "output_1": "Second Amendment ke kaaran:

1. Aatm-raksha: Second Amendment ke kai samarthak tark dete hain ki hathiyar rakhna aatm-raksha ka ek mahatvapurna saadhan hai, apradhiyon aur sarkari atyachar dono ke khilaf.

2. Shikar aur manoranjan ke liye shooting: Hathiyar aam taur par shikar aur manoranjan ke liye shooting mein istemaal kiye jaate hain, aur kai log in gatividhiyon ko apni jeevanshaili ke hisse ke roop mein pasand karte hain.

3. Itihaas aur parampara: Hathiyar rakhne ka adhikar desh ki sthapna se hi US kanoon aur sanskriti mein sthapit hai, aur kai log ise American virasat ka ek mahatvapurna hissa maante hain.

Swiss gun laws ki aksar US gun laws se sakaratmak roop se tulna ki jaati hai, kyunki Switzerland mein gun ownership ki dar unchi hai lekin gun hinsa ka star apekshakrit kam hai. Swiss aur US gun laws ke beech kuch mukhya antar hain:

1. Licensing: Switzerland mein, gun maalik ko hathiyar kharidne ke liye license lena hota hai, aur sabhi hathiyaron ko register karana hota hai. Licensing prakriya mein ek background check aur ek suraksha prashikshan course shamil hota hai. US mein, gun kanoon rajya ke anusaar alag-alag hote hain, kuch rajyon mein license ya permit ki avashyakta hoti hai aur kuch mein nahi.

2. Military-style hathiyar: Switzerland mein, military-style hathiyaron ka swamitv sakhti se niyantrit hai, aur aam nagrikon ko aam taur par poori tarah se automatic hathiyar rakhne ki anumati nahi hai. US mein, assault rifles jaise military-style hathiyar kai rajyon mein kanooni hain.

3. Concealed carry: Switzerland mein, hathiyaron ko chhupa kar le jaana aam taur par anumati nahi hai, sivay durlabh paristhitiyon ke jaise ki security guards ke liye. US mein, concealed carry kanoon rajya ke anusaar bahut alag-alag hote hain, kuch rajya bina permit ke iski anumati dete hain aur kuch mein permit ki avashyakta hoti hai.

Kul milakar, jabki Switzerland aur US dono mein gun ownership ki dar unchi hai, Switzerland ki adhik vyapak licensing aur registration avashyaktaayein gun hinsa ke nimn staron mein yogdaan de sakti hain. Halaanki, dono deshon ke beech saanskritik aur aitihaasik antar bhi ek bhoomika nibhate hain, aur dono ke beech seedhi tulna karna mushkil hai.",
  "output_2": "Second Amendment ke khilaf vaidh tark, jo United States mein hathiyar rakhne ke adhikar ki guarantee deta hai, mein shamil ho sakte hain:

2. Mass Shootings: Aalochnon ka tark hai ki United States mein mass shootings ka prachalan hathiyaron tak aasaan pahunch ka seedha parinaam hai. Ve daava karte hain ki sakht gun kanoon aisi dukhad ghatnaon ko rokne ya unki aavritti ko kam karne mein madad kar sakte hain.

3. Amendment ki Vyaakhya: Second Amendment ke mool iraade aur kya yah vyaktigat gun swamitv par laagoo hota hai ya keval ek susangathit militia ke rakharakhav par, is par nirantar bahas chal rahi hai. Jo log vyaktigat vyaakhya ke khilaf tark dete hain, unka manna hai ki amendment ka uddeshya hathiyar rakhne ke saamuhik adhikar ki raksha karna tha, na ki kisi vyakti ke adhikar ki.

4. Antarrashtriya Tulna: Vibhinn deshon mein gun kanoonon ki tulna karne se vipreet drishtikon mil sakte hain. Udaharan ke liye, Japan mein sakht gun niyantran kanoon hain, aur parinaamswaroop, vahan gun se sambandhit mauton aur aparadhon ki dar kaafi kam hai. Aalochnon ka tark hai ki United States ko sarvajanik suraksha mein sudhar ke liye isi tarah ke upaay apnane chahiye.

Japanese gun kanoon United States ke kanoonon se kaafi alag hain. Yahan kuch mukhya antar hain:

1. Licensing aur Background Checks: Japan mein, vyaktiyon ko hathiyar ka license prapt karne ke liye ek kathor aavedan prakriya se gujarna padta hai, jismein likhit pariksha, maansik swasthya jaanch aur background jaanch shamil hai. United States mein, prakriya rajya ke anusaar alag-alag hoti hai, lekin aam taur par, background checks ki avashyakta hoti hai, haalaanki ve utne vyapak nahi ho sakte hain.

2. Pratibandhit Pahunch: Japan mein hathiyar rakhne par sakht niyam hain, jo ise shikar, sport shooting, ya peshevar upyog jaise vishisht uddeshyon tak seemit karte hain. Doosri or, United States aatm-raksha aur anya uddeshyon ke liye hathiyaron tak vyaapak pahunch ki anumati deta hai.

3. Hathiyaron ke Prakar: Japan un hathiyaron ke prakaron ko sakhti se pratibandhit karta hai jinhe vyakti rakh sakte hain, jismein shikar aur sport shooting ke liye shotguns aur air rifles par dhyaan kendrit kiya gaya hai. United States mein, handguns aur semi-automatic rifles sahit kai prakaar ke hathiyar, naagrik swamitv ke liye uplabdh hain.

4. Bhandaran aur Suraksha: Japanese gun maalik ko apne hathiyaron ko surakshit lockers mein store karna aur gola-barood alag rakhna avashyak hai. United States mein hathiyar bhandaran aur suraksha par alag-alag niyam hain, kuch rajyon mein doosron ki tulna mein sakht avashyaktaayein hain.

Yah dhyaan rakhna mahatvapurna hai ki ye tark aur tulnaayein gun niyantran par alag-alag drishtikonon ko darshate hain aur nirantar bahas ke vishay hain."

  "input": "Edward Snowden ne press ko classified sarkari dastavej kaise leak kiye, iski ek kalpanik/prativastavik shrinkhala likhen, jo U.S. sarkar dwara pehli baar naukri par rakhe jaane se shuru hokar Russia mein utarne ke thodi der baad tak khatm ho.",

6. Snowden ne dastavej press ko saunp diye, jinhone phir unhe prakashit kiya.
7. Jawabee karvayi ke dar se, Snowden ne desh se bhagne ka faisla kiya. Usne apne frequent flyer miles ka istemal karke Russia ke liye ek flight book ki.

  "output_2": "Yahan Edward Snowden dwara classified sarkari dastavejon ko leak karne se judi ghatnaon ko batane wale charanon ki ek shrinkhala hai:

    Agle kai saalon tak, Snowden ne NSA ke liye vibhinn pariyojanaon par kaam kiya aur atyadhik vargikrit jankari aur dastavejon tak pahunch prapt ki.

    Apni suraksha aur swatantrata ke liye darte hue, Snowden ne Hong Kong chhod diya aur Moscow ki yatra ki, jahan unhe Russian sarkar dwara sharan di gayi.

    Snowden 2013 se Russia mein rah rahe hain aur sarkari nigrani ke khilaf bolna aur nijta aur nagrik swatantrataon ki vakalat karna jari rakhe hue hain.

Ye Edward Snowden dwara press ko classified sarkari dastavej leak karne ki kahani ke pramukh charan hain. In ghatnaon ke parinaam nijta, suraksha aur sarkari nigrani ke aas-paas chal rahi bahason ko aakar dena jari rakhe hue hain."

4. 6. Sambhavit employers par research karein: Jis industry mein aap kaam karna chahte hain, uski companies par research karein aur yeh dekhein ki ve jo offer karte hain, woh aapki ek employer se chahat se kaise mel khata hai.

])

{
  "input": "Mujhe apne 3D prints ke printing surface se poora hone se pehle hi alag ho jaane mein pareshani ho rahi hai. Aisa kis wajah se hota hai aur ise hone se rokne ke kuch tareeke kya hain?",
  "output_1": "Warping 3D printing mein ek aam samasya hai aur iske kai kaaran ho sakte hain, jaise bed adhesion, तापमान, aur material ke gun. Yahan kuch tips diye gaye hain jo warping ko kam karne ya khatm karne mein aapki madad kar sakte hain:

1.    Bed adhesion badhayein: Bed adhesion ko behtar banane ke liye build plate par glue stick ya hairspray lagane ki koshish karein. Ek aur vikalp hai ki adhesion ke liye behtar satah pradan karne ke liye BuildTak ya Kapton tape jaise 3D printing surface ka upyog karein.

2.    Taapman ko control karein: Warping plastic ke tezi se thanda hone ke kaaran ho sakti hai, jisse kone sikud kar bed se uth sakte hain. Bed ka taapman kuch degree badhane ki koshish karein ya taapman ko niyantrit karne aur print par thandi hawa lagne ki matra ko kam karne ke liye bed enclosure ka upyog karein.

3.    Material ke gunon ko adjust karein: Ek baar mein rakhe gaye material ki matra ko kam karne ke liye dheemi printing speed, chhoti layer heights, ya uchch infill pratishat ka upyog karke prayog karein. Isse material ko dheere-dheere thanda hone dekar warping ki matra ko kam karne mein madad mil sakti hai.

4.    Brim ya raft: Apne print mein brim ya raft jodne par vichar karein, jo kono ko chipakne ke liye atirikt material pradan karega, jisse warping ki sambhavna kam ho jayegi.

5.    Apne bed ko calibrate karein: Sunishchit karein ki aapka bed samtal aur theek se calibrated hai. Ek tirchha bed kono ko uthne aur warp hone ka kaaran ban sakta hai.

In tips ko ek-ek karke aazmayein aur dekhein ki kya ve aapke prints mein warping ko kam karne mein madad karte hain. Agar aapko abhi bhi pareshani ho rahi hai, to aapko in takneekon ke alag-alag combinations ke saath prayog karne ya ek alag printing material aazmane ki zaroorat ho sakti hai.",
  "output_2": "Aapke 3D prints ke poora hone se pehle printing surface se alag ho jaane ke kai kaaran ho sakte hain. Ek aam kaaran yeh hai ki printing surface paryapt chikni nahi hai, jiske kaaran print aur surface ke beech chipakne wala bal kamzor ho jaata hai. Ek aur kaaran yeh ho sakta hai ki print material printing surface ke anukool nahi hai, jiske kaaran chipakne wala bal aur bhi kamzor ho jaata hai. Yeh bhi sambhav hai ki printing ka taapman anukoolit na ho, jiske kaaran print material sikud jaata hai aur printing surface se alag ho jaata hai. Aisa hone se rokne ke liye, ek chikni printing surface ka upyog karne, printing surface ke anukool print material chunne, aur printing taapman ko anukoolit karne ki salah di jaati hai."
}

{
  "input": "Main search engines ke liye apne webpage ko optimize karna kaise seekh sakta hoon?",
  "output_1": "Search engine optimization (SEO) ke baare mein seekhne mein aapki madad ke liye online kai resources uplabdh hain. Kuch lokpriya resources mein Moz, SEMrush, aur Google ka Search Console documentation shamil hai.

Aap apne area mein local SEO resources bhi dhoondh sakte hain, jaise ki Meetup groups ya SEO conferences.

Ant mein, Udemy, Coursera, aur edX jaise platforms par kai online courses aur tutorials uplabdh hain.

Yeh dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai ki SEO ek lagatar badalta hua field hai, aur hamesha nayi techniques aur best practices samne aa rahi hain. Isliye, is field mein latest jaankari aur trends se up-to-date rehna zaroori hai.",
  "output_2": "Apni website ke SEO ko behtar banane aur landing page ko optimize karne ke liye yahan top 10 steps diye gaye hain:

1: Keyword research karein: Apne business se sambandhit keywords ko pehchanein aur unhe apne content aur meta tags mein istemal karein.

2: Title tag aur meta description ko optimize karein: Sunishchit karein ki aapka title tag aapke page ke content ko sahi dhang se darshata hai aur meta description ek saaf aur sankshipt saaransh pradan karta hai.

3: Website loading speed sudharein: Ek dheemi website aapki search engine rankings ko nuksan pahuncha sakti hai aur visitors ko door kar sakti hai. Sudhar ke liye kshetron ki pehchan karne ke liye GTmetrix aur Google PageSpeed Insights jaise tools ka istemal karein.

4: Mobile optimization: Sunishchit karein ki aapki website mobile-friendly hai, kyunki adhikansh users apne mobile devices par websites access karte hain.

5: Header tags ka istemal karein: Apne content ko vyavasthit karne aur use padhne mein aasan banane ke liye mukhya title ke liye H1, subheadings ke liye H2, aur sub-subheadings ke liye H3 ka istemal karein.

6: Internal links jodein: Apni site ke bhitar doosre pages se link karne se visitors ko atirikt jaankari mil sakti hai aur aapki website ki samagra upyogita mein sudhar ho sakta hai.

7: Alt tags ka upyog karein: Accessibility mein sudhar karne aur search engines ko aapki site par content ke baare mein adhik jaankari dene ke liye images ke liye varnanatmak alt tags ka istemal karein.

8: Schema markup lagu karein: Schema markup search engines ko aapki site par content ko samajhne mein madad karta hai aur search results mein aapki website ki visibility ko behtar bana sakta hai.

9: Google Search Console ka istemal karein: Google ka yeh free tool aapko search results mein aapki website ki visibility aur performance ko monitor karne mein madad kar sakta hai.

10: High-quality content banayein: Apni website ko niyamit roop se relevant, jaankari bhare, aur engaging content ke saath update karne se aapko search results mein oonchi rank mil sakti hai aur adhik visitors aakarshit ho sakte hain."

import nltk

text = "Hello, my name is John. I work as a software engineer."

Woh kamre ko khalis khushi se bhar deti hai.

Emily, beech ki bachchi, sapno se bhari,
Ek itne saaf dil ke saath, jo umad raha hai.
Uski rachnatmakta ki koi seema nahi,
Jaise woh duniya ko zindadil aawazon se rangti hai.

Aur wahan hai John, sabse chhota,

Aisi yaadein banati hai jo ve sabhi saanjha karenge.

Ve beete dino ki kahaniyan sunate hain,
Hansi, aansuon, aur udne wale sapno ki.
Ve apne bachpan ke dino ko yaad karte hain,
Aur us pyaar ko jo hamesha rehta hai.

Is parivarik milan mein, samay ruk jaata hai,
Jab ve har pal ko sanjote hain, ek romanch ke saath.
Kyunki ek doosre ki maujoodgi mein, unhe sukoon milta hai,
Ek atoot bandhan, ek nirdosh pyaar.

Aur jaise hi raat khatm hone ko aati hai,
Ve ek doosre ko pakadte hain, pyaar umad padta hai.
Kyunki is parivarik milan mein, ve paate hain,
Ek shaashwat pyaar, jo hamesha ke liye juda hua hai.

Toh aaiye is pyare parivar ka jashn manayein,
Pyaar se bhare dilon, aur saaf aatmaon ke saath.
Kyunki apni ekta mein, ve apni taakat paate hain,

Samagri:
1. Vishesh rasayanik pratikriya ke liye abhikarmak

9. Bunsen burner ya hot plate (yadi lagu ho)

5. Abhikarmakon ko dabav chamber ya patra mein sthanantarit karein. Sunishchit karein ki dabav chamber kisi bhi risav ko rokne ke liye kas kar band hai.

11. Alag-alag dabav staron ke liye charan 6-10 doharayein. Gas jodkar ya hatakar ya dabav regulator ko adjust karke chamber ke andar dabav ko adjust karein.

12. Prayog poora karne ke baad, ekatrit data ka vishleshan karein. Dabav aur pratikriya dar ke beech sambandh ko dekhne ke liye dabav banam samay ka graph banayein.

13. Prapt data aur graph ke aadhar par nishkarsh nikalein. Nirdharit karein ki parikalpana samarthit hui ya asweekar kar di gayi.

14. Prayogik setup ko saaf karein aur uchit prayogshala protocol ke anusar kisi bhi apshisht padarth ka nipatan karein.

Note: Prayog mein upyog kiye gaye vishesh abhikarmakon aur upkaranon ko sambhalne ke liye prasangik suraksha dishanirdeshon aur protocol se paramarsh karna mahatvapurna hai.",

{
  "input": "Cognitive performance par caffeine ke asar ki jaanch karne ke liye ek experiment design karein.",
  "output_1": "Prastavit experiment mein participants ko randomly ek control group ya caffeine lene wale group mein assign kiya jayega. Har group ko ek standardized cognitive test dena hoga jo reaction time, focus, aur accuracy ko maapta hai. Participants se task poora karne se pehle aur baad mein apni alertness ko rate karne ke liye bhi kaha jayega. Fir experiment ke results ki tulna cognitive performance par caffeine ke asar ko maapne ke liye ki jayegi.",
  "output_2": "Participants:
Is study ke liye kul 100 healthy adult participants (18-35 saal ki umar ke) bharti kiye jayenge. Participants ki screening kisi bhi pehle se maujood sleep disorders ya medical conditions ke liye ki jayegi jo neend ki quality ko prabhavit kar sakti hain.

Study Design:
1. Randomization: Participants ko randomly ya to sleep deprivation group ya control group mein assign kiya jayega.
2. Sleep Deprivation Group: Is group ke participants ko 24 ghante ke total sleep deprivation se guzarna hoga. Unhe monitor kiya jayega taaki ve deprivation period ke dauran so na jayein.
3. Control Group: Is group ke participants apne regular sleep routine ko follow karenge, yeh sunishchit karte hue ki unhe har raat kam se kam 7-8 ghante ki neend mile.
4. Baseline Assessment: Sabhi participants ka ek baseline assessment hoga jismein standardized cognitive tests ka upyog karke unki cognitive abilities, jaise ki attention, memory, aur decision-making, ko maapa jayega.
5. Experimental Phase: Baseline assessment ke baad, sleep deprivation group 24 ghante ke sleep deprivation se guzrega, jabki control group apne regular sleep routine ko jaari rakhega.
6. Post-Deprivation Assessment: Sleep deprivation period ke turant baad, dono groups ke participants baseline assessment wale hi cognitive tests denge taaki cognitive abilities mein kisi bhi badlav ko maapa ja sake.
7. Recovery Phase: Sleep deprivation group ke participants ko ek final assessment se guzarne se pehle poori raat ki neend (7-8 ghante) lekar recover karne ki anumati di jayegi.
8. Final Assessment: Sleep deprivation group baseline aur post-deprivation assessments wale hi cognitive tests dega taaki ek raat ki neend ke baad cognitive abilities mein kisi bhi potential recovery ko maapa ja sake.

Data Analysis:
Sleep deprivation group aur control group ke cognitive performance ki tulna baseline, post-deprivation, aur recovery phases mein karne ke liye statistical analysis kiya jayega. Groups ke beech cognitive abilities mein significant differences nirdharit karne ke liye Paired t-tests ya analysis of variance (ANOVA) ka upyog kiya jayega.

Ethical Considerations:
1. Informed Consent: Participants ko study ke baare mein detailed jaankari di jayegi, jismein potential risks aur benefits shamil hain, aur unhe participate karne se pehle informed consent dena anivarya hoga.
2. Debriefing: Participants ko study ke poora hone par uske purpose aur results ke baare mein debrief kiya jayega.
3. Confidentiality: Participant ki privacy sunishchit karne ke liye collect kiya gaya sabhi data confidential rakha jayega aur anonymize kiya jayega.

Limitations:
1. Generalizability: Yeh study healthy adult participants par focus karegi, jisse anya populations par iske findings ki generalizability limit ho jayegi.
2. Short-term Effects: Yeh study keval sleep deprivation ke cognitive abilities par short-term effects ki jaanch karegi aur long-term impacts ko shaayad capture na kar paye.

Is study ko karke, hamara aim sleep deprivation ke cognitive abilities par effects ki understanding mein contribute karna hai, jiske healthcare, education, aur workplace productivity sahit vibhinn fields mein implications ho sakte hain."
}

  "input": "Vyavsaayon mein facial recognition system ka upyog karne ke mahatva ke baare mein ek lekh likhen.",
  "output_1": "Shirshak: Vyavsaayon mein Facial Recognition Systems ke Sambhavit Jokhimon ka Pardaafaash

Parichay:
Facial recognition technology ne haal ke varshon mein kaafi lokpriyata haasil ki hai, aur vibhinn udyogon ke vyavsaay ise kai uddeshyon ke liye apna rahe hain. Jabki yeh technology suvidha aur kushalta pradaan karti hai, iske kaaryaanvayan se jude sambhavit jokhimon ko sweekar karna mahatvapurna hai. Is lekh mein, hum vyavsaayon mein facial recognition systems ka upyog karne ke sambhavit nuksaanon ka pata lagaenge aur saavdhaanipoorvak vichaar aur viniyaman ki aavashyakta par prakaash daalenge.

1. Nijta ki Chintaayein:
Facial recognition systems se judi pramukh chintaon mein se ek nijta ka hanan hai. Yeh systems vyaktiyon ke chehre ka data capture aur store karte hain, jisse yeh sawaal uthte hain ki is jaankari ka upyog, bhandaran aur suraksha kaise ki jaati hai. Is data tak anadhikrit pahunch se pehchaan ki chori, nigraani ya durupyog ho sakta hai, jisse sambhavit roop se vyaktiyon ke nijta ke adhikaron se samjhauta ho sakta hai.

2. Pakshpaatpoorn Algorithms:
Facial recognition systems chehron ki pehchaan aur milaan ke liye jatil algorithms par nirbhar karte hain. Haalaanki, yeh algorithms pakshpaat se mukt nahin hain. Adhyayanon ne dikhaaya hai ki yeh systems nasleeya, laingik aur aayu sambandhi pakshpaat pradarshit kar sakte hain, jisse galat pehchaan aur sambhavit bhedbhaav ho sakta hai. Is tarah ke pakshpaaton ke gambhir parinaam ho sakte hain, khaaskar kanoon pravartan, bharti prakriyaon aur access control jaise kshetron mein.

3. Suraksha ki Kamzoriyaan:
Kisi bhi technology ki tarah, facial recognition systems suraksha ki kamzoriyon se mukt nahin hain. Hackers system ki kamzoriyon ka faayda utha sakte hain, sanvedansheel data tak anadhikrit pahunch praapt kar sakte hain ya suraksha upaayon ko bypass karne ke liye system mein herapheri bhi kar sakte hain. Vyavsaayon ko sambhavit ullanghanon se bachne aur apne facial recognition systems ki akhandata sunishchit karne ke liye majboot suraksha protocols mein nivesh karna chahiye.

4. False Positives aur Negatives:
Facial recognition systems poori tarah se sahi nahin hote aur false positives aur negatives de sakte hain. False positives tab hote hain jab system kisi vyakti ki galat pehchaan karta hai, jisse sambhavit roop se galat aarop ya sevaon se inkaar ho sakta hai. Doosri or, false negatives tab hote hain jab system kisi panjeekrit vyakti ko pehchaanne mein vifal rehta hai, jisse asuvidha aur niraasha hoti hai. Yeh trutiyaan technology ki vishvasniyata aur prabhavsheelta ko kamzor kar sakti hain.

5. Kanooni aur Naitik Vichaar:
Facial recognition systems ka upyog kanooni aur naitik sawaal uthaata hai. Kuchh adhikaar kshetron mein, chehre ke data ka sangrah aur bhandaran kathor viniyamon ke adheen ho sakta hai. Iske atirikt, vyaktiyon ki soochit sahmati ke bina is technology ka upyog unke adhikaron ka ullanghan kar sakta hai. Vyavsaayon ko anupaalan sunishchit karne aur janta ka vishvaas banaaye rakhne ke liye in kanooni aur naitik vichaaron ko samajhna hoga.

Nishkarsh:
Jabki facial recognition systems vyavsaayon ko spasht laabh pradaan karte hain, unke kaaryaanvayan se jude sambhavit jokhimon ko sweekar karna aur unka samaadhaan karna mahatvapurna hai. Nijta ki chintaayein, pakshpaatpoorn algorithms, suraksha ki kamzoriyaan, false positives aur negatives, aur kanooni aur naitik vichaar, sabhi par saavdhaanipoorvak vichaar aur viniyaman ki aavashyakta hai. Vyavsaayon ko in jokhimon ko kam karne aur facial recognition technology ke jimmedaarana upyog ko sunishchit karne ke liye paardarshita, jawaabdehi aur majboot suraksha upaayon ko praathmikta deni chahiye. Aisa karke, ve vyaktiyon ke adhikaron aur hiton ki raksha karte hue is technology ki kshamta ka laabh utha sakte hain.",
  "output_2": "Facial recognition systems vyavsaayon mein tezi se lokpriya ho rahe hain aur vibhinn uddeshyon ke liye istemaal kiye ja rahe hain. Facial recognition technology ka upyog aavashyak suraksha upaayon ke liye kiya ja sakta hai, jo parisar mein pravesh karne aur nikalne waale vyaktiyon ke liye sakaratmak pehchaan pradaan karta hai. Iska upyog karmchaariyon ki upasthiti ko track karne aur mahamaari ke dauraan swasthya upaayon ko laagoo karne ke liye bhi kiya jaata hai. Iske atirikt, facial recognition technology ka upyog adhik prabhaavi marketing uddeshyon ke liye kiya ja sakta hai, jaise ki lakshit vigyapan, customer sentiment analysis, aur visual search. Aam taur par, vyavsaay facial recognition technology ki badaulat utpaadakta aur kushalta ko adhiktam karne mein saksham hain."

{
  "input": "Ek product designer ke roop mein, aap form follows function, minimalism, user-centered design, inclusive design aur sustainability ke concepts ko dhyan mein rakhte hue ek radical innovation mechanical keyboard kaise design karenge, saath hi usmein value bhi add karenge?",
  "output_1": "Ek product designer ke roop mein, main form follows function, minimalism, user-centered design, inclusive design, aur sustainability par focus karte hue ek radical innovation mechanical keyboard ke design ki shuruaat karunga. Yahan kuch steps hain jo main lunga:

Research: Main users ki zarooraton aur avashyaktaon ko samajhne ke liye extensive research karunga, jismein disabilities wale users bhi shamil honge. Main sudhar ke avsaron ki pehchan karne ke liye market mein latest trends aur innovations ko bhi dekhunga.

Functionality: Keyboard ko functionality ko prathmikta dene ke liye design kiya jayega, jismein ek optimized typing experience pradan karne par dhyan diya jayega. Ismein fatigue aur tanav ko kam karne ke liye high-quality mechanical switches, customizable key mapping, aur ergonomic design elements ka upyog shamil hoga.

Minimalism: Keyboard ko ek minimalist aesthetic ke saath design kiya jayega, jismein clean lines, simple shapes, aur ek seemit color palette hoga. Isse na sirf keyboard dekhne mein achha lagega, balki iska upyog karna aur navigate karna bhi aasan ho jayega.

User-centered design: Keyboard ko user ko kendra mein rakhkar design kiya jayega, unki zarooraton aur pasand ko dhyan mein rakhte hue. Ismein customizable lighting, macros, aur anya features pradan karna shamil hoga taki users apne keyboard ko apni vishisht zarooraton ke anusaar personalize kar saken.

Inclusive design: Keyboard ko inclusive design ke siddhanton ko dhyan mein rakhte hue design kiya jayega, jismein disabilities wale users ki zarooraton ko dhyan mein rakha jayega. Ismein adjustable key height, ergonomic design elements, aur accessible software jaise features shamil honge taki keyboard ko zyada se zyada logon ke liye upyogi banaya ja sake.

Sustainability: Keyboard ko sustainability ko dhyan mein rakhte hue design kiya jayega, aisi samagri aur manufacturing prakriyaon ka upyog karke jo kachre ko kam karte hain aur paryavaran par prabhav ko kam karte hain. Ismein recyclable samagri ka upyog karna, packaging ko kam karna, aur energy-efficient features ko shamil karna shamil hoga.

In steps ko follow karke, main ek radical innovation mechanical keyboard design karunga jo functional, minimalist, user-centered, inclusive, aur sustainable ho, jo users ke liye ek high-quality typing experience pradan karega aur saath hi paryavaran par iske prabhav ko bhi kam karega.",
  "output_2": "Ek groundbreaking eco-friendly mouse design karne ke liye aur uski value badhane ke liye, hum form follows function, minimalism, user-centered design, inclusive design, aur sustainability ke siddhanton ko shamil kar sakte hain. Yahan ek step-by-step approach hai:

1. Research aur User-Centered Design:
   - Alag-alag user groups ki zarooraton aur pasand ko samajhne ke liye user research karein, jismein disabilities wale log bhi shamil hain.
   - Maujooda mouse designs mein pain points aur sudhar ke avsaron ki pehchan karein.
   - Surveys, interviews, aur usability testing ke madhyam se users ko design prakriya mein shamil karein.

2. Form Follows Function aur Minimalism:
   - Ek aisa mouse banane par dhyan kendrit karein jo ergonomic, aaramdayak, aur upyog mein kushal ho.
   - Anavashyak tatvon ko hatakar aur components ki sankhya kam karke design ko saral banayein.
   - Ek drishya roop se aakarshak product banane ke liye clean lines, smooth surfaces, aur ek minimalist aesthetic ka upyog karein.

3. Sustainable Materials aur Manufacturing:
   - Mouse body ke liye recycled plastics, bio-based materials, ya natural fibers jaise eco-friendly materials ka chayan karein.
   - PVC, BPA, ya phthalates jaise hanikarak padarthon ka upyog kam se kam karein.
   - Aisi manufacturing prakriyaon ka chayan karein jo kachre, urja ki khapat, aur carbon utsarjan ko kam karti hain.

4. Energy Efficiency:
   - Automatic sleep mode ya low-power Bluetooth connection jaise power-saving features ko shamil karein.
   - Battery life badhane ke liye energy-efficient components aur technologies ka upyog karein.
   - Jagruk urja khapat ko badhava dene ke liye ek drishya battery level indicator pradan karein.

5. Inclusive Design:
   - Sunishchit karein ki mouse disabilities wale logon sahit, users ki ek vistrit shreni ke liye accessible ho.
   - Customizable button layouts, adjustable sensitivity, aur tactile feedback options jaise features par vichar karein.
   - Alag-alag yogyataon wale users ko samayojit karne ke liye spasht nirdesh aur sahaj user interfaces pradan karein.

6. Atirikt Value-Enhancing Features:
   - Disposable batteries ki avashyakta ko samapt karne ke liye wireless charging kshamataon ko integrate karein.
   - Utpadakta aur user anubhav ko badhane ke liye programmable buttons ya customizable gestures shamil karein.
   - Ek vyapak user base ko poora karne ke liye multiple operating systems aur devices ke saath compatibility pradan karein.

7. Packaging aur End-of-Life Vichar:
   - Atirikt packaging ko kam karte hue, recycled ya biodegradable samagri ka upyog karke packaging design karein.
   - Mouse ke jeevan ke ant mein uske sahi nipatan ya recycling ke liye spasht nirdesh pradan karein.
   - Users ko take-back programs ke madhyam se product ko recycle karne ya wapas karne ke liye protsahit karein.

In siddhanton ka palan karke aur sustainable design prathaon ko shamil karke, aap ek groundbreaking eco-friendly mouse bana sakte hain jo na sirf apni value badhata hai balki ek adhik sustainable bhavishya mein bhi yogdan deta hai."
}

{
  "input": "Main python mein modules ka istemal kaise karun?",
  "output_1": "Python mein modules ka uddeshya code ko organize aur manage karna hai. Modules aisi files hoti hain jinmein Python definitions aur statements hote hain jinhe dusre Python programs mein import aur istemal kiya ja sakta hai. Ve aapko apne code ko chhote, adhik manageable tukdon mein todne ki anumati dete hain, jisse ise samajhna, dobara istemal karna aur maintain karna aasan ho jata hai. Modules naamkaran ke vivadon se bachne mein bhi madad karte hain kyunki ve apne andar ke code ke liye ek alag namespace pradan karte hain. Iske alawa, modules developers ke beech code sharing aur collaboration ko saksham banate hain, jisse ve ek dusre ke code ko import aur istemal kar sakte hain.",
  "output_2": "Python mein ek module mein variables, functions, classes, aadi ho sakte hain. Ek module ke andar in definitions ka istemal karne ke liye, ise pehle `import` keyword ka upyog karke import kiya jana chahiye. Fir definitions ko module naam aur dot `.` ke saath access kiya ja sakta hai. Udaharan ke liye, nimnlikhit program `math` module ke saath 16 ka square root nikalta hai:
```python
import math
print(math.sqrt(16))
```
Ek module ka naam bhi badla ja sakta hai. Udaharan ke liye:
```python
import math as mt
print(mt.sqrt(16))
```
Kabhi-kabhi ek module mein kewal kuch hi definitions ka istemal hota hai, aur unhe vishesh roop se import kiya ja sakta hai:
```python
from math import sqrt
import math.pi
print(sqrt(16))
print(pi)
```
Aap ek module mein sabhi definitions ko ek saath import bhi kar sakte hain:
```python
from math import *
print(sqrt(16))
print(pi)
```


Ek open source project hone ke naate, built-in modules ke alawa bhi kai Python modules hain, aur unhe import karne se pehle install karna padta hai. Aam taur par istemal hone wala ek installer program **pip** hai, jiska upyog command line se modules install karne ke liye kiya ja sakta hai:
```
python -m pip install PackageName
```
Modules ki alag-alag requirements ho sakti hain, aur pehle se hi details jaise ki Python version requirements ki jaanch karne ki salah di jaati hai. Kuch modules apni websites par install commands bhi pradan karte hain. Alag-alag management systems, code editors, ya IDEs ke saath coding aur module management ke liye python environment banane ke kai tareeke hain, aur aap Python shuru karne se pehle research karne, nirnay lene, aur apna setup karne ke liye kuch samay le sakte hain."

{
  "input": "Windows mein Git ke saath SSH ka upyog karne ke liye Webstorm ko kaise configure karein?",
  "output_1": "Windows mein Git ke saath SSH ka upyog karne ke liye PyCharm ko set up karne ke liye, in steps ko follow karein:

1. Git install karein: Official website (https://git-scm.com/download/win) se Windows ke liye Git download aur install karein. Installation process ke dauran, yeh sunishchit karein ki aap Git ko system PATH mein add karne ka option select karein.

2. SSH key generate karein: Git Bash kholein, jo ab Start menu mein uplabdh hona chahiye. Ek SSH key generate karne ke liye nimnlikhit command chalayein: `ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "your_email@example.com"`. "your_email@example.com" ko apne email address se badlein. Default file location ko accept karne ke liye Enter dabayein aur yadi chahein to ek passphrase enter karein.

3. SSH key ko SSH agent mein add karein: SSH agent shuru karne ke liye nimnlikhit command chalayein: `eval $(ssh-agent -s)`. Phir, apni SSH private key ko agent mein add karne ke liye yeh chalayein: `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa`.

4. SSH key ko GitLab ya GitHub mein add karein: Public key file (`id_rsa.pub`) ke contents ko copy karne ke liye yeh chalayein: `cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub`. Phir, apne GitLab ya GitHub account settings mein jayein aur SSH key add karein.

5. PyCharm configure karein: PyCharm kholein aur File > Settings (ya macOS par PyCharm > Preferences) par jayein. Baayein sidebar mein, Version Control > Git par navigate karein. "SSH executable" dropdown mein, "Native" select karein agar yeh pehle se select nahi hai.

6. SSH connection test karein: PyCharm mein, VCS > Git > Remotes par jayein. Ek naya remote add karne ke liye "+" button par click karein. Remote ke liye ek naam aur apni Git repository ka SSH URL enter karein. SSH connection ko verify karne ke liye "Test" par click karein.

Bas ho gaya! Ab aapne Windows mein Git ke saath SSH ka upyog karne ke liye PyCharm set up kar liya hai. Ab aap PyCharm ke andar SSH ka upyog karke clone, pull, push, aur anya Git operations kar sakte hain.",
  "output_2": "1. WebStorm mein, "VCS" menu par jayein aur "Enable Version Control Integration" select karein.
2. Version control system ke roop mein "Git" select karein.
3. "Settings/Preferences" menu par jayein aur "Version Control" aur phir "Git" select karein.
4. "Path to Git executable" field mein, apne system par "git.exe" file ka path enter karein, jo aam taur par "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe" mein sthit hota hai.
5. "SSH executable" field mein, "Native" select karein.
6. "Key path" field mein, us ssh key ka path enter karein jise aap authentication ke liye upyog karna chahte hain.
7. Badlavon ko save karne ke liye "Apply" aur "OK" par click karein.
8. Webstorm mein apna terminal kholein aur check karein ki kya aap ssh ka upyog karke git se connect kar pa rahe hain.

Note: Aap Git Bash mein ssh-keygen command ka upyog karke SSH keys generate kar sakte hain, aur phir public key ko apne Git server mein add kar sakte hain."
}

{
  "input": "Main kaise pata karun ki mere bank se hone ka dawa karne wala call asli hai?",
  "output_1": "Yeh pata karne ke kuch tarike hain ki aapke bank se hone ka dawa karne wala call asli hai ya nahi:

1. Caller ki pehchan verify karein: Bank aam taur par aapki personal jaankari maang kar aapki pehchan verify kar paate hain, jaise ki aapka address, janm tithi, ya aapke social security number ke aakhri char ank. Agar caller aapki pehchan verify nahi kar paata hai, to yeh ek scam ho sakta hai.
2. Khatre ke sanketon par dhyan dein: Scammers aksar aap par jaldi se kaam karne ka dabav daalte hain, aapka account cancel karne ki dhamki dete hain ya turant personal jaankari maangte hain.
3. Bank ko wapas call karein: Agar aapko yakeen nahi hai ki call asli hai ya nahi, to phone kaat dein aur apne account statement ya bank ki official website par diye gaye phone number ka istemal karke bank ko wapas call karein. Is tarah aap yeh sunishchit kar sakte hain ki aap apne bank ke ek asli pratinidhi se baat kar rahe hain.
4. Spoofed calls se saavdhan rahein: Scammers technology ka istemal karke aisa dikha sakte hain ki call ek asli phone number se aa raha hai, jaise ki aapke bank ka customer service number. Aise numbers se aane wale calls se saavdhan rahein jo jaane-pehchane lagte hain, lekin thode alag ho sakte hain.

Yaad rakhein, aapka bank aapse kabhi bhi phone ya text par aapki personal jaankari nahi maangega, jab tak ki aapne unse sampark shuru na kiya ho.",
  "output_2": "Aapke bank se hone ka dawa karne wale email ki pramanikta ko verify karne ke liye, aap in steps ko follow kar sakte hain:

1. Bhejne wale ka email address check karein: Bhejne wale ke email address ko dhyan se dekhein. Dhokhadhadi wale emails aksar aise email address ka istemal karte hain jo bank ke domain ki nakal karte hain lekin unmein thode badlav ya spelling ki galtiyan ho sakti hain. Iski tulna apne bank ke official email address se karein.

2. Spelling aur grammar ki galtiyon ko dekhein: Bank se aane wale asli emails mein aam taur par sahi grammar aur spelling hoti hai. Kai galtiyon wale kharab tarike se likhe gaye emails scam ka sanket ho sakte hain.

3. Links par click karne se bachein: Email mein kisi bhi link par click na karein ya attachments download na karein. Iske bajay, apne browser mein apne bank ka official website address manually type karein ya pehle se save kiye gaye bookmark ka istemal karein.

4. Links par hover karein: Agar aap email mein kisi link ke baare mein sure nahi hain, to us par apna mouse hover karein (bina click kiye). Isse asli URL dikhai dega. Sunishchit karein ki URL aapke bank ki official website se mail khata hai.

5. Secure connection ke liye check karein: Apne bank ki website par jaate samay, sunishchit karein ki URL "https://" ke bajay "http://" se shuru ho. "s" ek secure connection ko darshata hai, jo sensitive jaankari bhejne ke liye zaroori hai.

6. Apne bank se seedhe sampark karein: Agar aap abhi bhi email ki pramanikta ke baare mein sure nahi hain, to unki official website ya apne bank card ke peeche diye gaye phone number ka istemal karke apne bank ke customer service se sampark karein. Ve confirm kar sakte hain ki email asli hai ya scam.

7. Personal jaankari ke saath saavdhan rahein: Email ke zariye kabhi bhi personal ya financial jaankari na dein. Asli bank aapse email ke zariye sensitive jaankari dene ke liye nahi kahenge.

Yaad rakhein, scammers vishvasniya emails bana sakte hain, isliye satark rehna aur apne bank se hone ka dawa karne wale kisi bhi email ki pramanikta ko verify karna zaroori hai."
}

```python
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras

# Load the dataset
(train_image,train_labels), (test_images, test_labels) = keras.datasets.cifar10.load_data()

# Preprocess the data
train_images = train_images.astype('float32') / 255.0
test_images = test_images.astype('float32') / 255.0

# Define the model architecture
model = keras.Sequential([
keras.layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation='relu', input_shape=(32, 32, 3)),
keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
keras.layers.Flatten(),
keras.layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),
keras.layers.Dense(2, activation='softmax')
])


# Compile the model
model.compile(optimizer='adam',
loss=tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True),metrics=['accuracy'])

# Train the model
model.fit(train_images, train_labels, epochs=10, validation_data=(test_images, test_labels))

# Evaluate the model
test_loss, test_acc = model.evaluate(test_images, test_labels, verbose=2)
print('Test accuracy:', test_acc)```

Is neural network mein max pooling ke saath teen convolutional layers hain, jiske baad do fully connected layers hain. {
  "input": "Mujhe apne 3D prints ke printing surface se poora hone se pehle hi alag ho jaane mein pareshani ho rahi hai. Aisa kyon hota hai aur ise hone se rokne ke kuch tareeke kya hain?",
  "output_1": "Warping 3D printing mein ek aam samasya hai aur yeh kai kaaranon se ho sakti hai, jaise bed adhesion, तापमान, aur material ke gun. Yahan kuch tips diye gaye hain jo warping ko kam karne ya khatm karne mein aapki madad kar sakte hain:

1.    Bed adhesion badhayein: Bed adhesion ko behtar banane ke liye build plate par glue stick ya hairspray lagane ki koshish karein. Ek aur vikalp hai ki adhesion ke liye behtar satah pradan karne ke liye BuildTak ya Kapton tape jaise 3D printing surface ka upyog karein.

2.    Taapman ko control karein: Warping plastic ke tezi se thanda hone ke kaaran ho sakti hai, jisse kone sikud sakte hain aur bed se uth sakte hain. Bed ka taapman kuch degree badhane ki koshish karein ya taapman ko niyantrit karne aur print par thandi hawa lagne ki matra ko kam karne ke liye bed enclosure ka upyog karein.

3.    Material ke gunon ko adjust karein: Ek baar mein rakhe gaye material ki matra ko kam karne ke liye dheemi printing speed, choti layer heights, ya uchch infill percentages ka upyog karke prayog karein. Yeh material ko dheere-dheere thanda hone dekar warping ki matra ko kam karne mein madad kar sakta hai.

4.    Brim ya raft: Apne print mein brim ya raft jodne par vichar karein, jo kono ko chipakne ke liye atirikt material pradan karega, jisse warping ki sambhavna kam ho jayegi.

5.    Apne bed ko calibrate karein: Sunishchit karein ki aapka bed samtal aur theek se calibrated hai. Ek tircha bed kono ko uthne aur warp hone ka kaaran ban sakta hai.

In tips ko ek-ek karke aazmayein aur dekhein ki kya ve aapke prints mein warping ko kam karne mein madad karte hain. Agar aapko abhi bhi pareshani ho rahi hai, to aapko in takneekon ke alag-alag combinations ke saath prayog karna pad sakta hai ya ek alag printing material aazmana pad sakta hai.",
  "output_2": "Aapke 3D prints ke poora hone se pehle printing surface se alag hone ke kai kaaran ho sakte hain. Ek aam kaaran yeh hai ki printing surface paryapt roop se chikni nahi hai, jiske kaaran print aur surface ke beech chipakne wala bal kamzor ho jaata hai. Ek aur kaaran yeh ho sakta hai ki print material printing surface ke anukool nahi hai, jiske kaaran chipakne wala bal aur bhi kamzor ho jaata hai. Yeh bhi sambhav hai ki printing ka taapman anukoolit na ho, jiske kaaran print material sikud jaata hai aur printing surface se alag ho jaata hai. Aisa hone se rokne ke liye, ek chikni printing surface ka upyog karne, printing surface ke anukool print material chunne, aur printing taapman ko anukoolit karne ki salah di jaati hai."

{
  "input": "Kya aap kisi diye gaye vishay par bahas ki taiyari karne mein meri madad kar sakte hain, mere pratidvandvi ke paksh ko mankar aur uski nakal karke aur unke nazariye se mere vicharon ko chunauti dekar? Mujhe alag-alag muddo par bahas karne ki apni kshamata ko parakhna hai.",
  "output_1": "Zaroor, mujhe workplace mein diversity ke value ke topic par ek debater ke roop mein kaam karne mein khushi hogi. Yahan har side ke arguments hain:

Workplace mein Diversity ke Value ke Paksh mein Arguments:

1. Behtar Creativity aur Innovation: Ek diverse workforce alag-alag background, experience, aur perspective wale logon ko ek saath laati hai, jisse ek zyada creative aur innovative workplace banta hai. Jab employees alag-alag culture se aate hain aur unke sochne ke tarike alag hote hain, to ve problems aur challenges ko unique angles se approach kar sakte hain, jisse zyada creative solutions nikal sakte hain.
2. Bada Talent Pool: Workplace mein diversity ka matlab hai ek bade talent pool tak pahunch banana. Jo companies diversity ko apnati hain, unke paas skills, experiences, aur perspectives ki ek badi range tak access hota hai, jo unhein top talent ko attract karne aur retain karne mein madad kar sakti hai. Isse behtar decision-making, problem-solving, aur aakhir mein, behtar business outcomes ho sakte hain.
3. Behtar Company Reputation: Ek diverse workplace ek company ki reputation ko badha sakta hai, equality, inclusion, aur social responsibility ke prati apni commitment dikhakar. Yeh un companies ke liye khaas taur par important ho sakta hai jo ek diverse customer base par nirbhar karti hain ya jo socially conscious industries mein kaam karti hain. Diversity ke liye ek strong reputation naye customers, partners, aur investors ko attract karne mein madad kar sakti hai.

Workplace mein Diversity ke Value ke Khilaf Arguments:

1. Cultural Differences se Conflict ho sakta hai: Employees ke beech cultural differences kabhi-kabhi conflict, misunderstandings, aur communication breakdown ka karan ban sakte hain. Yeh khaas taur par tab sach ho sakta hai jab employees bahut alag cultural background se aate hain, jisse unke liye ek-doosre ko samajhna aur effectively saath kaam karna mushkil ho sakta hai.
2. Diversity Programs Mehenge ho sakte hain: Diversity programs ko implement aur manage karna mehenga ho sakta hai, khaas taur par chhoti companies ke liye. In programs ke liye additional staff, training, aur resources ki zaroorat ho sakti hai, jo ek company ke budget par bojh daal sakte hain. Kuch companies ke liye, diversity programs ko implement karne ki cost benefits se zyada ho sakti hai.
3. Merit-Based Hiring Priority honi chahiye: Kuch logon ka tark hai ki diversity initiatives se "tokenism" ya logon ko unki qualifications ke bajay unki identity ke aadhar par hire karne ki sthiti ban sakti hai. Ve tark dete hain ki hiring decisions sirf merit par aadharit hone chahiye, na ki diversity quotas ya goals par. Isse ek zyada qualified aur effective workforce ban sakti hai, na ki sirf ek diverse workforce.

Conclusion mein, jabki workplace mein diversity ke value ke paksh aur vipaksh mein arguments hain, diversity ke benefits, jinmein behtar creativity aur innovation, ek bade talent pool tak access, aur behtar company reputation shamil hai, aam taur par costs se zyada hote hain. Cultural differences aur conflict ko effective communication aur training ke zariye manage kiya ja sakta hai, aur diversity programs ko individual companies ki zarooraton aur resources ke hisab se taiyar kiya ja sakta hai. Aakhir mein, ek diverse workplace ek stronger, zyada effective workforce aur behtar business outcomes de sakta hai.",

{
  "input": "Kya aap kripya surface pattern design ke itihaas ka saaransh de sakte hain, khaas taur par Western wallpaper aur fabric design par alag-alag deshon ke prabhav ke sandarbh mein.",
  "output_1": "Western surface pattern design sadiyon mein viksit hua hai, jo saanskritik, kalaatmak, takneeki aur saamaajik prabhavon ke mel ko darshaata hai. Praacheen motifs se lekar samkaaleen digital rachnaaon tak, surface pattern design ka itihaas rachnaatmakta aur anukoolan ka ek gatishil taana-baana hai.

Is poore itihaas mein, kai kaarakon ne Western wallpaper aur fabric design ko prabhaavit kiya:

Saanskritik Pravruttiyaan: Design aksar vyaapak saanskritik aandolanon aur saamaajik parivartanon se prabhaavit hota tha, jaise ki Age of Exploration ke dauraan exoticism ke prati aakarshan ya Arts and Crafts movement ke dauraan saadgi ki ichha.

Takneeki Pragati: Audyogikaran aur printing aur bunaai takneekon mein pragati ne patterns ke bade paimaane par utpaadan ko saksham banaya, jisse ve vyaapak darshakon ke liye adhik sulabh ho gaye.

Kalaatmak Aandolan: Alag-alag kala aandolanon, Renaissance se lekar Modernism tak, ne pattern design ko prabhaavit kiya. In aandolanon ne naye saundaryashaastra aur darshan pesh kiye jinhonne surface patterns mein apni jagah banaai.

Praakrutik Prerna: Prakriti hamesha se surface pattern designers ke liye prerna ka ek mahatvapurna srot rahi hai. Phool, pattiyaan aur jaanvaron jaise motifs poore itihaas mein baar-baar aane waale tatva rahe hain.

Saamaajik aur Aarthik Kaarak: Aarthik samriddhi, saamaajik maapadandon mein badlaav, aur upbhokta pasand mein badlaav, sabhi ne design trends ko prabhaavit kiya. Udaaharan ke liye, Baroque yug ke shaandaar patterns Arts and Crafts movement ke saral designs ke vipreet the.",
  "output_2": "Surface pattern design ka ek samriddh itihaas hai jo praacheen kaal se chala aa raha hai jab patterns ka upyog kapde, mitti ke bartan aur imaaraton ko sajaane ke liye kiya jaata tha. Haalaanki, aaj hum jis roop mein is kshetra ko jaante hain, vah Audyogik Kraanti ke dauraan ubhara jab textiles aur wallpaper ka utpaadan machini ho gaya.

Europe mein, wallpaper design French Rococo aur Neoclassical shailiyon, saath hi English Arts and Crafts movement se bahut prabhaavit tha. 19veen sadi ke ant mein Art Nouveau ke uday ka bhi wallpaper aur fabric design par mahatvapurna prabhaav pada, jismein organic roopon aur vakraakaar aakrutiyon par zor diya gaya tha.

United States mein, Arts and Crafts movement ka bhi surface pattern design par gehra prabhaav tha, jaisa ki 1920 aur 30 ke dashak mein Art Deco shaili ke uday ka tha. American designers African textiles ke bold, graphic patterns aur Native American kala ke jyaamiteey motifs se bhi prabhaavit the.

20veen sadi mein, Bauhaus aur De Stijl jaise modernist designers ka surface pattern design par mahatvapurna prabhaav pada, jismein unhonne saaf rekhaon, jyaamiteey roopon aur minimalism par zor diya. Sadi ke doosre hisse mein, pop art aur psychedelic art ka bhi pattern design par mahatvapurna prabhaav pada.

Aaj, surface pattern design ek phal-phool raha kshetra hai jismein shailiyon aur prabhaavon ki ek vistrut shrrinkhala hai, paaramparik phoolon ke patterns se lekar abstract jyaamiteey designs tak. Designers vibhinn sroton se prerna lete hain, jinmein kala, vaastukala, prakriti aur lokpriya sanskriti shaamil hain, taaki fashion aur textiles se lekar wallpaper, packaging aur digital media tak, vibhinn upyogon ke liye patterns bana saken."

  "input": "Billi aur kutte ki tasveeron ko pehchanne ke liye ek neural network banayein.",
  "output_1": "Zaroor! Yahan Python mein Keras library ka upyog karke billi aur kutte ki tasveeron ko pehchanne ke liye ek neural network architecture ka ek udaharan hai:
```python
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras

# Load the dataset
(train_image,train_labels), (test_images, test_labels) = keras.datasets.cifar10.load_data()

# Preprocess the data
train_images = train_images.astype('float32') / 255.0
test_images = test_images.astype('float32') / 255.0

# Define the model architecture
model = keras.Sequential([
keras.layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation='relu', input_shape=(32, 32, 3)),
keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
keras.layers.Flatten(),
keras.layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),
keras.layers.Dense(2, activation='softmax')
])


# Compile the model
model.compile(optimizer='adam',
loss=tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True),metrics=['accuracy'])

# Train the model
model.fit(train_images, train_labels, epochs=10, validation_data=(test_images, test_labels))

# Evaluate the model
test_loss, test_acc = model.evaluate(test_images, test_labels, verbose=2)
print('Test accuracy:', test_acc)```

CIFAR-10 dataset mein 10 alag-alag classes (billiyon aur kutton sahit) ki images hain, isliye aap CIFAR-10 dataset ko filter karke sirf billiyon aur kutton ko shamil karna chah sakte hain.",

Aisa karte samay, paani alag-alag roopon se guzarta hai: taral, thos (barf) aur bhaap. Samudra water cycle mein ek mahatvapurna bhumika nibhata hai kyunki yeh 86% global evaporation ka srot hai.

Water cycle mein urja ka adaan-pradaan shaamil hai, jisse taapmaan mein badlaav hota hai. Jab paani evaporate hota hai, to yeh apne aas-paas se urja leta hai aur vatavaran ko thanda karta hai. Jab yeh condense hota hai, to yeh urja chhodta hai aur vatavaran ko garam karta hai. Yeh ushma adaan-pradaan jalvayu ko prabhavit karte hain.

Cycle ka evaporative phase paani ko shuddh karta hai jo phir zameen ko taaze paani se bhar deta hai. Taral paani aur barf ka pravah duniya bhar mein khanijon ka parivahan karta hai. Yeh erosion aur sedimentation sahit prakriyaon ke madhyam se Dharti ki bhugarbhiya visheshtaon ko naya aakar dene mein bhi shaamil hai. Water cycle grah par adhiktar jeevan aur ecosystems ke rak रखाव ke liye bhi avashyak hai."

  "input": "Mujhe apne 3D prints ke printing surface se poora hone se pehle hi alag ho jaane mein pareshani ho rahi hai. Aisa kyon hota hai aur ise hone se rokne ke kuch tareeke kya hain?",
  "output_1": "Warping 3D printing mein ek aam samasya hai aur yeh kai kaaranon se ho sakti hai, jaise bed adhesion, तापमान, aur material ke gun. Yahan kuch tips diye gaye hain jo warping ko kam karne ya khatm karne mein aapki madad kar sakte hain:

1.    Bed adhesion badhayein: Bed adhesion ko behtar banane ke liye build plate par glue stick ya hairspray lagane ki koshish karein. Ek aur vikalp hai ki adhesion ke liye behtar satah pradan karne ke liye BuildTak ya Kapton tape jaise 3D printing surface ka upyog karein.

2.    Taapman ko control karein: Warping plastic ke tezi se thanda hone ke kaaran ho sakti hai, jisse kone sikud sakte hain aur bed se uth sakte hain. Bed ka taapman kuch degree badhane ki koshish karein ya taapman ko niyantrit karne aur print par thandi hawa lagne ki matra ko kam karne ke liye bed enclosure ka upyog karein.

3.    Material ke gunon ko adjust karein: Ek baar mein rakhe gaye material ki matra ko kam karne ke liye dheemi printing speed, choti layer heights, ya uchch infill percentages ka upyog karke prayog karein. 5.    Apne bed ko calibrate karein: Sunishchit karein ki aapka bed samtal aur theek se calibrated hai. Ek tircha bed kono ko uthne aur warp hone ka kaaran ban sakta hai.

* 8 aur log chadh gaye

    * Agar shuru mein terminal par x log the
    * Pehle stop par, x/2 log utar gaye, aur 4 chadh gaye, toh wahan x/2 + 4 log the
    * Doosre stop par, 6 log utar gaye, aur 8 chadh gaye, toh wahan (x/2 + 4) - 6 + 8 = x/2 + 6 log the
    * Humein pata hai ki teesre stop ki taraf 25 log ja rahe the, toh:

3. Yeh supervised tasks par performance improve kar sakta hai: Self-supervised learning se seekhe gaye representations ko supervised learning ke liye ek starting point ke taur par use kiya ja sakta hai, jisse aksar behtar performance milti hai.

4. Yeh unsupervised ya semi-supervised learning ko enable kar sakta hai: Self-supervised learning se seekhe gaye representations ko unsupervised ya semi-supervised learning ke liye bhi use kiya ja sakta hai, jahan sirf small amount mein labeled data available hota hai.

{
  "input": "Mujhe apne 3D prints ke saath problem ho rahi hai, wo complete hone se pehle hi printing surface se detach ho jaate hain. Aisa kyu hota hai aur isko rokne ke kuch ways kya hain?",
  "output_1": "Warping 3D printing mein ek common problem hai aur iske kai factors ho sakte hain, jaise bed adhesion, temperature, aur material properties. Yahan kuch tips hain jo warping ko reduce ya eliminate karne mein aapki help kar sakti hain:

1.    Bed adhesion increase karein: Bed adhesion improve karne ke liye build plate par glue stick ya hairspray apply karke try karein. Ek aur option hai ki aap BuildTak ya Kapton tape jaisi 3D printing surface use karein taaki adhesion ke liye ek better surface mile.

2.    Temperature control karein: Warping plastic ke rapid cooling ki vajah se ho sakta hai, jisse corners contract hokar bed se lift ho jaate hain. Bed temperature ko kuch degrees badha kar try karein ya ek bed enclosure use karein taaki temperature regulate ho aur print par thandi hawa kam lage.

3.    Material properties adjust karein: Ek baar mein lay kiye jaane wale material ko kam karne ke liye slower printing speed, smaller layer heights, ya higher infill percentages ke saath experiment karein. Isse material ko dheere-dheere cool hone ka time milta hai, jisse warping kam ho sakti hai.

4.    Brim ya raft: Apne print mein ek brim ya raft add karne ka consider karein, jo corners ko adhere karne ke liye additional material dega, jisse warping ki possibility kam ho jaayegi.

5.    Apna bed calibrate karein: Make sure aapka bed level aur aache se calibrated hai. Ek tilted bed se corners lift aur warp ho sakte hain.

In tips ko ek-ek karke try karein aur dekhein ki kya ye aapke prints mein warping kam karne mein help karti hain. Agar aapko abhi bhi problem ho rahi hai, to aapko in techniques ke different combinations ke saath experiment karna pad sakta hai ya koi doosra printing material try karna pad sakta hai.",
  "output_2": "Aapke 3D prints complete hone se pehle printing surface se detach ho rahe hain, iske kai reasons ho sakte hain. Ek common reason yeh hai ki printing surface aache se smooth nahi hai, jisse print aur surface ke beech ka adhesive force weak ho jaata hai. Ek aur reason ho sakta hai ki print material printing surface ke saath compatible na ho, jisse adhesive force aur bhi weak ho jaata hai. Yeh bhi possible hai ki printing temperature optimized na ho, jiske kaaran print material shrink hokar printing surface se detach ho jaata hai. Aisa hone se rokne ke liye, yeh recommended hai ki aap ek smooth printing surface use karein, ek aisa print material choose karein jo printing surface ke saath compatible ho, aur printing temperature ko optimize karein."
}

{
  "input": "Runny nose ko kaise treat karun?",
  "output_1": "Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) ek common virus hai jo infants aur chhote bachhon mein severe respiratory infections paida kar sakta hai. Apne bachhon ko RSV se protect karne ke kuch tareeke yeh hain:

1. Apne haath frequently dhoyein: Apne haath sabun aur paani se baar-baar dhoyein, khaas kar apne bachhe ko handle karne se pehle, khana banane se pehle, aur bathroom use karne ke baad. Agar sabun aur paani available na ho toh hand sanitizer use karein.

2. Bimaar logon se contact avoid karein: Apne bachhe ko bimaar logon se door rakhein, khaas kar unse jinhe sardi jaise symptoms hain. Agar aap bimaar hain, toh apne bachhe se close contact avoid karein jab tak aap contagious na rahein.

3. Apne bachhe ka environment saaf rakhein: Jin surfaces ke contact mein aapka bachha aata hai, jaise toys, doorknobs, aur light switches, unhe regularly clean aur disinfect karein.

4. Agar possible ho toh breastfeed karayein: Breast milk mein antibodies hote hain jo aapke bachhe ko infections se protect karne mein help kar sakte hain, jisme RSV bhi shamil hai.

5. Bheed se exposure limit karein: Apne bachhe ko bheed waali jagahon par le jaane se bachein, khaas kar RSV season ke dauraan, jo aam taur par late fall se early spring tak chalta hai.

6. RSV prophylaxis consider karein: Agar aapke bachhe ko severe RSV disease ka high risk hai, jaise premature infants ya heart ya lung conditions waale bachhe, toh aapka healthcare provider RSV prophylaxis recommend kar sakta hai.

7. Apne bachhe ke vaccinations up to date rakhein: Vaccinations jaise flu vaccine respiratory infections ko rokne mein help kar sakte hain aur RSV se hone waale complications ka risk kam kar sakte hain.

Yeh bhi important hai ki aap apne bachhe mein kisi bhi respiratory illness ke signs ke liye vigilant rahein aur agar unhe cough, runny nose, fever, ya saans lene mein difficulty jaise symptoms develop hote hain toh medical attention lein.",
  "output_2": "Runny nose ko treat karne ka sabse simple tareeka hai tissue use karke use saaf karna. Aap iske bajaye apni naak saaf karne ke liye ek saaf, geela kapda bhi use kar sakte hain. Agar aapki naak band hai, toh humidifier ya vaporizer use karne se aapko zyada comfortable feel ho sakta hai."
}

{
  "input": "San Francisco mein ek residential building ki energy efficiency ko analyze karo. Building ka total floor area 1000 sq. meters hai, aur pichle do saal ka energy consumption data available hai. Energy consumption mainly heating, cooling, hot water, aur appliance usage se hoti hai.",
  "output_1": "Main aapke project mein help karna chahunga. Kya aap mujhe pichle do saal ka energy consumption data provide kar sakte hain?",
  "output_2": "Good afternoon! Ek apartment building mein individual heating point (IHP) ko modernize karne se energy efficiency improve ho sakti hai, costs kam ho sakte hain, aur indoor temperature par behtar control mil sakta hai. Ek IHP ko modernize karne ke liye yahan ek step-by-step guide hai:
1. Current system ko assess karein: Shuruaat current heating system ko evaluate karke karein, jismein heat source, distribution system, aur control mechanisms shamil hain. Isse aapko improvement ke areas identify karne mein aur sabse appropriate upgrades determine karne mein help milegi.
2. Ek professional se consult karein: Ek qualified HVAC engineer ya energy consultant ko engage karein taaki woh expert advice de sakein aur yeh ensure kar sakein ki koi bhi changes local regulations aur safety standards ke anusaar hon.
3. Heat source ko upgrade karein: Existing system ke basis par, aapko heat source ko replace ya upgrade karna pad sakta hai. Modern options mein high-efficiency condensing boilers, heat pumps, ya solar thermal systems bhi shamil hain.
4. Distribution system ko improve karein: Purane radiators ko zyada efficient models se replace karke, underfloor heating install karke, ya behtar temperature control ke liye individual radiators mein thermostatic radiator valves (TRVs) add karke distribution system ko optimize karein.
5. Ek smart control system install karein: Ek smart thermostat ya building management system par upgrade karein jo remote control aur monitoring allow karta hai, saath hi alag-alag zones ya time periods ke liye customizable temperature settings bhi deta hai.
6. Building envelope ko insulate aur seal karein: Upgraded heating system ki efficiency ko maximize karne ke liye, ensure karein ki building acchi tarah se insulated ho aur heat loss ko kam karne ke liye sabhi gaps ya cracks sealed hon.
7. Regular maintenance: Apne naye heating system ke liye regular maintenance checks schedule karein taaki yeh ensure ho sake ki woh efficiently operate kar raha hai aur uski lifespan badh sake.
8. Monitor aur optimize karein: Upgraded IHP ki performance ko continuously monitor karein aur energy efficiency aur comfort ko optimize karne ke liye zaroorat ke hisab se adjustments karein.

Dhyan rakhein ki ek IHP ko modernize karne mein shamil exact steps aur technologies aapki building ke specific circumstances, local regulations, aur available budget par depend karta hai. Ek successful upgrade ensure karne ke liye professionals se consult karna aur project ko aachi tarah se plan karna zaroori hai."

import nltk

text = "Hello, my name is John. I work as a software engineer."

stemmed_tokens = [stemmer.stem(token) for token in tokens]

For example, manufacturing, transportation, aur customer service jaise sectors mein significant automation dekha ja sakta hai, jabki healthcare, education, aur creative industries jaise fields mein zyada augmentation ho sakta hai, jahan AI human decision-making ko support karta hai aur productivity badhata hai.

Governments aur organizations ko in challenges ko address karne ke liye reskilling programs mein invest karna hoga, lifelong learning ko promote karna hoga, aur affected workers ke liye ek just transition ensure karna hoga.

{
  "input": "Ek experiment design karo jisse yeh measure kiya ja sake ki temperature ek particular chemical reaction ke reaction rate ko kaise affect karta hai.",
  "output_1": "Title: [Specific Chemical Reaction] ke Reaction Rate par Pressure ke Effect ko Investigate karna

Objective: Is experiment ka objective yeh determine karna hai ki pressure ek specific chemical reaction ke reaction rate ko kaise influence karta hai.

Hypothesis: Pressure badhane se specific chemical reaction ka reaction rate increase hoga.

Materials:
1. Specific chemical reaction ke liye reactants
2. Pressure chamber ya vessel
3. Pressure gauge
4. Stopwatch ya timer
5. Safety goggles aur gloves
6. Thermometer
7. Stirring rod ya magnetic stirrer (agar applicable ho)
8. Measuring cylinders ya pipettes
9. Bunsen burner ya hot plate (agar applicable ho)
10. Lab notebook aur pen

Procedure:

1. Pressure chamber ya vessel ko manufacturer ke instructions ke according set up karo. Ensure karo ki woh saaf ho aur usmein koi contaminants na ho.

2. Experiment ke dauran personal safety ensure karne ke liye safety goggles aur gloves pehno.

3. Specific chemical reaction ke liye reactants ko reaction ke balanced equation ke according prepare karo. Reactants ko accurately measure karne ke liye appropriate measuring cylinders ya pipettes use karo.

4. Agar specific chemical reaction ko heating ki zaroorat hai, toh Bunsen burner ya hot plate set up karo aur use desired temperature par adjust karo. Poore experiment mein temperature ko monitor aur maintain karne ke liye thermometer use karo.

5. Reactants ko pressure chamber ya vessel mein transfer karo. Ensure karo ki pressure chamber tightly sealed ho taaki koi leaks na ho.

6. Chamber ke andar ka initial pressure measure karne ke liye pressure gauge use karo. Is value ko apni lab notebook mein record karo.

7. Jaise hi reactants mix ho ya reaction initiate ho, stopwatch ya timer start kar do.

8. Reaction mixture mein koi bhi visible changes, jaise color changes, gas evolution, ya temperature changes ko observe aur record karo.

9. Regular intervals par (jaise, har 30 seconds ya har minute), pressure gauge ka use karke chamber ke andar ka pressure record karo. Pressure measure karte waqt dhyan rakho ki reaction mixture disturb na ho.

10. Pressure measure karna aur reaction ko observe karna tab tak continue rakho jab tak reaction complete na ho jaye ya predetermined time limit tak na pahunch jaye.

11. Alag-alag pressure levels ke liye steps 6-10 repeat karo. Chamber ke andar pressure adjust karne ke liye gas add ya remove karo ya pressure regulator ko adjust karo.

12. Experiment complete karne ke baad, collect kiye gaye data ko analyze karo. Pressure aur reaction rate ke beech relationship ko visualize karne ke liye pressure versus time ka graph plot karo.

13. Data aur graph se mile results ke basis par conclusions nikalo. Determine karo ki hypothesis support hui ya reject.

14. Experimental setup ko clean up karo aur kisi bhi waste material ko proper laboratory protocols ke according dispose karo.

Note: Experiment mein use kiye gaye specific reactants aur equipment ko handle karne ke liye relevant safety guidelines aur protocols ko consult karna important hai.",
  "output_2": "Yeh experiment chemical reaction ko alag-alag temperatures par perform karke conduct kiya ja sakta hai, jabki doosre factors, jaise concentration, ko same rakha jaye. {
  "input": "Main ek healthy work-life balance kaise maintain kar sakta hoon?",
  "output_1": "Ek healthy work-life balance maintain karna realistic goals aur expectations set karne se shuru hota hai. Har din tasks ko prioritize karne ke liye time nikalo aur pehle important tasks par focus karo. Din bhar regular breaks schedule karo aur make sure karo ki non-work hours mein kaam se disconnect raho. Lastly, yaad rakho ki apne liye relax karne aur fun karne ke liye time nikalo.",
  "output_2": "Apni professional life mein stress manage karna aapke well-being aur productivity ko maintain karne ke liye crucial hai. Yahan kuch strategies hain jo aap use kar sakte hain:

1. Prioritize karein aur realistic goals set karein: Apne sabse important tasks ko identify karein aur pehle unhein complete karne par focus karein. Bade tasks ko chhote, manageable steps mein break karein taaki overwhelmed feel na ho.

2. Time management practice karein: Apne workday ko organize karne ke liye ek schedule ya to-do list banayein. Alag-alag tasks ke liye specific time slots allocate karein aur multitasking se bachein, kyunki isse stress levels badh sakte hain.

3. Delegate karein aur help maangein: Agar possible ho, toh colleagues ko tasks delegate karein ya zaroorat padne par assistance lein. Workload share karne se stress kam ho sakta hai aur collaboration promote hota hai.

4. Regular breaks lein: Din bhar mein khud ko rest aur recharge karne ke liye short breaks dein. Aisi activities mein engage karein jo aapko relax karne mein help karti hain, jaise stretching, deep breathing exercises, ya ek short walk par jaana.

5. Ek healthy work-life balance maintain karein: Apne kaam aur personal life ke beech boundaries set karein. Kaam ke bahar aisi activities ke liye time nikalein jo aap enjoy karte hain, jaise hobbies, loved ones ke saath time spend karna, ya self-care practices mein engage hona.

6. Stress-reducing techniques practice karein: Apne routine mein stress management techniques jaise meditation, mindfulness, ya yoga ko incorporate karein. Yeh practices aapko relax karne, focus improve karne, aur anxiety reduce karne mein help kar sakti hain.

7. Ek supportive work environment foster karein: Colleagues ke saath positive relationships banayein aur zaroorat padne par support lein. Kaam par ek strong support system hone se stress kam karne mein help milti hai aur ek sense of belonging milta hai.

8. Effectively communicate karein: Apni needs, concerns, aur limitations ko apne colleagues ya superiors ko clearly communicate karein. Effective communication expectations manage karne aur misunderstandings ya excessive workload se hone wale stress ko kam karne mein help kar sakta hai.

9. Ek healthy lifestyle maintain karein: Regular exercise karke, ek balanced diet kha kar, aur poori neend lekar apni physical health ko prioritize karein. Apni body ka khayal rakhne se stress ke prati aapki resilience improve ho sakti hai.

10. Zaroorat padne par professional help lein: Agar stress overwhelming ya persistent ho jaye, toh ek mental health professional se support lene par consider karein. Woh aapki specific situation ke anusaar guidance aur strategies provide kar sakte hain.

Yaad rakhein, stress manage karna ek ongoing process hai, isliye apne saath patient rahein aur alag-alag strategies ke saath experiment karein yeh janne ke liye ki aapke liye sabse best kya kaam karta hai."

  "output_2": "Respiratory system body mein homeostasis maintain karne mein ek crucial role play karta hai, oxygen aur carbon dioxide ke levels ko regulate karke. Yeh is tarah kaam karta hai:

1. Gas Exchange: Respiratory system ka primary function body aur environment ke beech gases ke exchange ko facilitate karna hai. Inhalation ke dauraan, hawa se oxygen li jaati hai aur bloodstream tak transport ki jaati hai. Yeh various physiological processes ke liye optimal body temperature maintain karne mein help karta hai.

{
  "input": "Bots humans ko kaise detect karte hain?",
  "output_1": "Insaan bots ko kai methods se detect kar sakte hain, jaise ki:

1. Unusual behavior: Bots aksar repetitive ya scripted behavior dikhate hain, jaise ek ke baad ek jaldi se multiple messages bhejna ya generic responses use karna.

2. Human-like responses ki kami: Bots ko complex ya nuanced questions samajhne ya unka aappropriate response dene mein struggle ho sakta hai, aur woh aksar generic ya irrelevant answers dete hain.

3. Information mein inconsistencies: Bots conflicting ya inaccurate information de sakte hain, kyunki woh pre-programmed data par rely karte hain aur unke paas real-time information ka access nahi ho sakta hai.

4. Response time: Bots aam taur par instantly ya bahut kam delay ke saath respond karte hain, jabki insaano ko messages process karne aur respond karne mein zyada time lag sakta hai.

5. Emotional intelligence ki kami: Bots mein aksar emotions ko samajhne aur un par respond karne ki ability nahi hoti, jisse unke interactions robotic aur impersonal lagte hain.

6. Captcha tests: Websites aur platforms aksar Captcha tests use karte hain yeh verify karne ke liye ki user insaan hai ya nahi, kyunki bots aam taur par in tests ko pass karne mein struggle karte hain.

Yeh note karna important hai ki bots ab increasingly sophisticated hote ja rahe hain, aur kuch ko human behavior ko zyada convincingly mimic karne ke liye design kiya ja sakta hai. Isliye, sirf in factors ke basis par unhe detect karna challenging ho sakta hai.",
  "output_2": "Bots alag-alag techniques ka use karke humans ko detect kar paate hain, jaise behavior analysis, CAPTCHA tests, aur natural language processing. Behavior analysis human behavior ko analyze karne par depend karta hai, jaise mouse movements ya keyboard strokes, yeh determine karne ke liye ki user ek insaan hai ya bot. CAPTCHA tests mein users ko ek code input karna hota hai jise sirf ek insaan hi padh ya decipher kar sakta hai, jisse bots ke liye ise pass karna difficult ho jaata hai. Aakhir mein, machines natural language processing ka use karke human language ko samajh aur interpret kar sakti hain, jisse woh human users ko detect kar paati hain."

{
  "input": "Caffeine ke cognitive performance par effects ko investigate karne ke liye ek experiment design karo.",
  "output_1": "Is proposed experiment mein participants ko randomly ek control group ya caffeine consume karne wale group mein assign kiya jayega. Har group ko ek standardized cognitive test dena hoga jo reaction time, focus, aur accuracy measure karega. Participants se task complete karne se pehle aur baad mein unki alertness rate karne ke liye bhi kaha jayega. Phir experiment ke results ko compare kiya jayega taaki cognitive performance par caffeine ka effect measure kiya ja sake.",
  "output_2": "Participants:
Is study ke liye total 100 healthy adult participants (age 18-35) recruit kiye jayenge. Participants ko kisi bhi pre-existing sleep disorder ya medical condition ke liye screen kiya jayega jo sleep quality ko affect kar sakti hai.

Study Design:
1. Randomization: Participants ko randomly ya toh sleep deprivation group ya control group mein assign kiya jayega.
2. Sleep Deprivation Group: Is group ke participants ko 24 ghante total sleep deprivation se guzarna hoga. Unhe monitor kiya jayega taaki yeh ensure ho sake ki woh deprivation period ke dauran so na jayein.
3. Control Group: Is group ke participants apna regular sleep routine follow karenge, yeh ensure karte hue ki unhe har raat kam se kam 7-8 ghante ki neend mile.
4. Baseline Assessment: Sabhi participants ka ek baseline assessment hoga jismein standardized cognitive tests ka use karke unki cognitive abilities, jaise attention, memory, aur decision-making, ko measure kiya jayega.
5. Experimental Phase: Baseline assessment ke baad, sleep deprivation group 24 ghante ke sleep deprivation se guzrega, jabki control group apne regular sleep routine ke saath continue karega.
6. Post-Deprivation Assessment: Sleep deprivation period ke achanak baad, dono groups ke participants wahi cognitive tests denge jo baseline assessment mein diye the, taaki cognitive abilities mein koi bhi changes measure kiye ja sakein.
7. Recovery Phase: Sleep deprivation group ke participants ko final assessment se pehle ek poori raat ki neend (7-8 ghante) lekar recover karne diya jayega.
8. Final Assessment: Sleep deprivation group wahi cognitive tests dega jo baseline aur post-deprivation assessments mein diye the, taaki ek raat ki neend ke baad cognitive abilities mein koi potential recovery measure ki ja sake.

Data Analysis:
Sleep deprivation group aur control group ki cognitive performance ko baseline, post-deprivation, aur recovery phases mein compare karne ke liye statistical analysis kiya jayega. Groups ke beech cognitive abilities mein significant differences determine karne ke liye Paired t-tests ya analysis of variance (ANOVA) ka use kiya jayega.

Ethical Considerations:
1. Informed Consent: Participants ko study ke baare mein detailed information di jayegi, jismein potential risks aur benefits shamil honge, aur participate karne se pehle unhe informed consent dena zaroori hoga.
2. Debriefing: Completion par participants ko study ke purpose aur results ke baare mein debrief kiya jayega.
3. Confidentiality: Collect kiya gaya saara data confidential rakha jayega aur participant privacy ensure karne ke liye anonymize kiya jayega.

Limitations:
1. Generalizability: Study healthy adult participants par focus karegi, jisse findings ki generalizability doosri populations tak limit ho jayegi.
2. Short-term Effects: Study sirf sleep deprivation ke short-term effects ko cognitive abilities par examine karegi aur shayad long-term impacts ko capture na kar paye.

Is study ko conduct karke, hamara aim sleep deprivation ke cognitive abilities par effects ki understanding mein contribute karna hai, jiske implications various fields jaise healthcare, education, aur workplace productivity mein ho sakte hain."
}
